verdict.rationale: Brave's Web Search docs say results return ranked titles and URLs, and the Answers endpoint can include inline citation tags, which covers the core of citing sources. The docs mention date-based filtering of searches, but they never document a published-date field on each result or say the URLs are canonical. missing for 10: documented per-result published-date field, explicit canonical-URL guarantee, response schema/field reference, independent corroboration of metadata accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on results carrying canonical URLs, titles, and published dates so my app can cite sources accurately

citations.quote: Ranked titles, URLs, and short snippets for a results page
